players.product: long-haul / middle-mile fiber construction for hyperscaler data-center interconnect

quarterly_data.signal: CEO: all-time record fourth-quarter revenue of $1,460,000,000, up 34.4% vs Q4 fiscal 2025 and up 16.6% organically (a Q4 record in total and organic); adjusted EBITDA $162,400,000 at an 11.1% margin (+41 basis points), with workforce additions and severe winter storms weighing on margin; 'No pull-forwards.' Full fiscal 2026: record revenue of $5,550,000,000 (+17.9%, +6.5% organic), adjusted EBITDA $737,700,000 at a 13.3% margin (+105 basis points), free cash flow more than doubled to $435,300,000 (CFO: +216%); book-to-bill 1.3x total and 1.2x organic for the year.
quarterly_data.figure: Q4 revenue $1,460,000,000 (+34.4%, +16.6% organic); adj. EBITDA $162,400,000 (11.1%); FY2026 revenue $5,550,000,000 (+17.9%), adj. EBITDA margin 13.3%; free cash flow $435,300,000; book-to-bill 1.3x

quarterly_data.signal: Initial fiscal 2027 outlook: total revenue $6,850,000,000 to $7,150,000,000 (approximately 23.6% to 29% growth, 6.6% to 10.3% organic); Communications $5,700,000,000 to $5,900,000,000 with modest adjusted EBITDA margin gains; Building Systems $1,150,000,000 to $1,250,000,000 at a mid-teens adjusted EBITDA margin. Drivers: strong fiber-to-the-home demand, increasing long-haul and middle-mile fiber builds, growing inside-the-fence opportunities, modest service/maintenance growth, 'exceptional demand for electrical services in a growing data center market'; wireless equipment replacement revenue to decline by approximately $100,000,000 with a further step down in fiscal 2028. Q1 outlook: revenue $1,640,000,000 to $1,710,000,000 and adjusted EBITDA $200,000,000 to $220,000,000. Margin gains are 'not coming from us increasing pricing with our customers' but from operating leverage and internal efficiencies.

Long-haul / middle-mile / inside-the-fence data-center fiber: 'Existing networks lack the capacity and latency required to support growing data consumption and AI inference'; hyperscalers collectively raised capex guidance to nearly $718,000,000,000 (approximate 70% increase year-over-year). The $20,000,000,000 addressable market 'continues to grow' and the CEO 'strongly' believes it is more than that; it is back-half weighted, ramping this year and in 2027, with builds starting in earnest in calendar 2028. 'we are getting more phone calls and seeing more opportunities than we saw even a quarter ago or, frankly, even a week ago'. Dycom continues to secure new inside-the-fence awards; near-term hyperscale revenue is led by the Lumen overpull program plus shorter 100 or 200 mile routes, while routes of thousands of miles come later.
quarterly_data.figure: $20,000,000,000 addressable market (growing); hyperscaler capex guidance nearly $718,000,000,000 (approximate 70% increase); builds start in earnest in calendar 2028

quarterly_data.signal: Building Systems (Power Solutions data-center electrical, acquired for $1,950,000,000 and closed December 23): Q4 stub revenue $95,800,000 and adjusted EBITDA $11,100,000 (11.6% of segment revenue). Fiscal 2027 growth guided at 15% to 25% (trailing four-year CAGR about 15%); the business has around 3,000 electricians and over a billion dollars of revenue, working on dozens of data centers; demand in the DMV 'is just off the charts'. 'the hyperscalers buy all the big electrical equipment directly. That does not come through the P&L of Power Solutions' - growth is labor-driven. Hyperscaler cross-sell of inside-the-fence Communications work with Power Solutions' inside-the-four-walls work is 'taking flight even earlier than we anticipated'; M&A pipeline focused on other in-data-center systems beyond electrical.
quarterly_data.figure: Building Systems Q4 revenue $95,800,000, adj. EBITDA $11,100,000 (11.6%); FY2027 Power Solutions growth 15% to 25%; around 3,000 electricians

quarterly_data.signal: Q4 customer mix (CFO): AT&T and Lumen each exceeded 10% of total revenue, contributing $350,500,000 and $147,700,000; following Verizon's acquisition of Frontier, their combined revenue was $205,600,000 (also above 10%); BrightSpeed, Charter, Comcast and Uniti each exceeded 5% of consolidated revenue. Service and maintenance delivered over 50% of Communications revenue in fiscal 2026.

Skilled-labor capacity: workforce now over 19,500; breaking ground on a new training facility outside of Atlanta (multiweek residential programs, serving both Communications and Building Systems). With fiber-to-the-home, hyperscaler long-haul/middle-mile, wireless and BEAD programs stacking, management anticipates 'an industry-wide shortage of skilled labor', with pressure on labor 'later this year and really starting in calendar 2027'; heavy Communications headcount additions in the back half weigh on near-term margin expansion.

Fiber-to-the-home and BEAD: customers affirmed or raised passing goals; current industry commitments represent nearly 6,000,000 additional passings, with drops taking an average of four years to reach terminal penetration. BEAD: NTIA has cleared states representing more than $30,000,000,000 and moved over $17,000,000,000 into funding; Dycom's verbal awards increased from the $500,000,000 noted last quarter and should move to contracted backlog in Q1 or Q2, with first revenue in Q2 and larger builds in calendar 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: nearly 6,000,000 fiber-to-the-home passings; BEAD verbal awards increased from the $500,000,000 noted last quarter

connects_to.relationship: contracting services customer (10-K >10% of contract revenues)

contracts.signal: Dycom believes it was 'first on the field executing Lumen's overpull program' (long-haul fiber overpull for hyperscaler capacity); Lumen announced another $2,500,000,000 of awards this quarter to bolster its build, and Dycom expects its revenue to continue to ramp this year delivering the program. Lumen exceeded 10% of Dycom's Q4 revenue, contributing $147,700,000.
contracts.value: $147,700,000 (Dycom Q4 revenue from Lumen); Lumen's own new awards $2,500,000,000
contracts.date_signed: program Dycom has been working on for over a year; revenue to ramp this year
